milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the acacia_planks building and face it. The building center is at spawn-relative (11, 2, 11). With max_distance=5, the player must walk from spawn [0,0,0] to within 5 blocks of the building center, which means reaching approximately [7-15, y, 7-15] — requiring ~8+ blocks of navigation. This prevents false triggering at spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~16.4 blocks, well outside the 5-block threshold). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the acacia_planks structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red_carpet (from 2 red_wool placed in a horizontal row) produces red_carpet items that end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 2 red_wool and 0 red_carpet, so having at least 1 red_carpet in inventory confirms successful crafting. The recipe yields 3 red_carpet from 2 red_wool. This works in either the 2x2 inventory grid or the crafting table provided in the scene.
